summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, announcing the retirement of Geert Van Poelvoorde as CEO of ArcelorMittal Europe, effective end of July. He will assume the role of Chairman of the Board of ArcelorMittal Europe Steel. The change is a planned executive retirement, not forced, and is accompanied by a board appointment. No financial terms, advisor, or shareholder vote are mentioned. This is a routine leadership transition which does not trigger a change of control or special shareholder action. There are no risk-arb or regulatory clock considerations.
